category_title: Reactive bully-victims with SEBD who respond to peer harassment with physical aggression
scenario_title: Peer provocation and reactive physical aggression
minimal_context: The student is attempting to navigate social interactions with mainstream peers during recess.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for recess. You can go interact with the other students and join their games.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They would not let me in any games. I just sit there alone.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Why don't you go over to their desks and try talking to them again?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: They are bullying me, saying really mean things about me and my father.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just ignore what they are saying and try to get along.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Throws a chair) They were bullying me, calling me names, hurting me! You won't do anything about it, so I'm going to kick them! It's self-defence!
